The file lists the vortex centres (nm) seen in a model image of the Abrikosov vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor in a perpendicular magnetic field. Model conditions: the only measured input is the applied magnetic field (117.3 G = 11.73 mT) reported by Cottet et al. (arXiv:1401.4062; MgB2, cryo-Lorentz TEM at 5 K); the vortices form an ideal triangular lattice with exactly one superconducting flux quantum per vortex, no pinning disorder, lattice defects or thermal motion, and a uniform field, which is the idealization the paper compares its images with; the map is a finite patch of about 97 vortices in an arbitrary orientation. In a small-angle neutron scattering experiment on this lattice, at what scattering vector q (q = 4π sinθ/λ) does the first-order Bragg peak of the vortex lattice appear, in μm⁻¹?

选项：
A. 2.56 μm⁻¹
B. 13.93 μm⁻¹
C. 16.08 μm⁻¹
D. 27.85 μm⁻¹

附件：vortex-MgB2-1173G.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文实测磁场（或实测晶格常数）构建的理想三角涡旋晶格模型（约 97 个涡旋，确定性旋转）；不是实测涡旋位置。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
